title: Downward conditional monotonicity gives survival and extinction for contact processes in random environments
summary: The concept of downward conditional monotonicity for the Markov-modulated Poisson process (MMPP) is introduced and used to derive the optimal stochastic domination of a standard Poisson point process. The maximum arrival rate for the Poisson process which allows this domination to exist is shown to be related to an eigenvalue extracted from the generator matrix of the quasi-birth--death (QBD) formulation of the MMPP.
